title: Lisa and the Elevator That Went Down First
synopsis: Lisa and Grandpa ride a library elevator the wrong direction at first, discover the book carts below, and finally reach the upstairs picture books.

related_resources.reason: The picture-book visit provides a familiar context for a child and caregiver to notice details together.
The repeated motion words and Grandpa’s playful response are narrative choices related broadly to caregiver-child interaction, without a claimed outcome.
